0022600136.text: The Toronto Raptors (2-1, 1-0 at home, on a one-game losing streak) host the Orlando Magic (1-2, 0-2 at home, on a one-game winning streak) in the fourth game of Toronto's season, with the Raptors 2nd in the Atlantic and the Magic 4th in the Southeast, each one game back. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee, inflammation), and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring, strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle, sprain), with Jalen Suggs listed as day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Raptors won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 139-87 win in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
